versions.changelog:
efficiency-gold-miner-sop-alchemy-universal v1.0.0

- Initial release: A robust skill for identifying and transforming repetitive work traces in digital workflows into actionable automation opportunities, daily reports, and tomorrow’s tasks.
- Supports DingTalk/Wukong dws and can adapt to Google Workspace and other enterprise ecosystems; uses only authorized connectors and data.
- Strictly enforces user privacy, platform security, explicit user confirmation before all writing actions, and never invents resource identifiers.
- Outputs always include traceable evidence sources, closed-loop process status, and clear automation opportunity cards with prioritization (P0/P1/P2).
- Provides demo/“演示模式” with fixed sample data for safe showcasing; no data monitoring or performance surveillance features.
- Thorough error handling and misuse prevention per scenario, with detailed operation boundaries and fallback strategies.
